purpose: Causal-order greedy combination of the complete MLP responses that the upstream atlas found material for the distributed L11/L15 post-cue c_v interface.

authority.target: Joint normalized residual of the literal L11H1/H3 and L15H5 post-cue c_v/c_proj response, with L9H1/H4 clamped as in the parent.

selection: At each causal program width, add the remaining complete MLP whose joint discovery objective is smallest. Discovery rows have even group_number; odd groups are evaluation-only. Freeze the prefix with the smallest discovery objective, breaking ties by shorter width and lexical site order.

predictions.pred_a_authority_capture_monotonic_inven: Authorities, six-site pool, all 21 triangular greedy trials, finite metrics, native attention reconstruction, and <=25 forwards/750 examples pass with zero fitting/backwards/updates.
predictions.pred_b_greedy_program_materially_reduces: Best-prefix discovery objective improves by >=.10 from the unclamped objective 1.0 and every selected step is non-increasing.
predictions.pred_c_best_prefix_is_jointly_sufficient: On evaluation rows, every layer-by-panel residual norm fraction is <=.90 and their mean is <=.75.
predictions.pred_d_discovery_to_evaluation_is_stable: The best-prefix evaluation objective is no more than .15 above its discovery objective.
predictions.pred_e_distributed_program_uses_multiple: The best prefix contains at least two complete MLP modules.

decision: Screen freezes the selected causal-order MLP union for capability-gated fresh confirmation, then splits no MLP until weight-factor tests require it. Null preserves MLP9 as the stable singleton and redirects the unexplained response to the direct MLP8 residual skip.
